correctness.rationale: Two independently structured executable finite certificates list all 161280 order-five labelled Latin squares, all 288000 legal intercalate edges, 17280 isolated states and eight 18000-vertex components. Complete enumeration checks sign-triple consistency for every one of 120^3 isotopies; a distinct Python construction verifies transitive even-isotopy orbit and odd cosets. Exact BFS from a seed plus verified transitive graph-automorphism action proves the displayed radius/diameter and distance spectrum for every mobile vertex. The proof is exhaustive for the specified finite domain, not an inference from sampling.

value.rationale: This classifies reachability and sharp move costs under a standard elementary Latin-square trade at the first tractable nontrivial order; the classical two-vertex isotopy quotient obscures eight genuine labelled components and many frozen states. The natural parity-sign obstruction is proved sufficient, not only necessary, and complete distance profiles give reproducible benchmarks for trade-based algorithms. This is a complete natural finite classification, not an arbitrary statistic.
